The pages that I just couldn't make anything more about are: Page8 - her hand on her boobs; page93 - left part of page, above her leg; page109 - her hand above the butt panel (tried there, but still looks bad); page116 - her hands (both the top left&right panel); page118 - bottom panel, her hand that intersects her foot from the above panel (I did try, but it still looks kinda eh); all the pages that have the tittle of said chapter and on page121, the big text with their faces/x-ray inside(I'm not THAT good yet to remove them).

Update3(21.09): Welp.. self set deadline wasn't kept sadly... BUT! On the upside, there is just one more chapter left and it will be done! If there are any mistakes/thinks I have missed/pages missing/critiques, do fell free to let me know. Also, I managed to fix some of the things I left undone before, like: page10(her hand above her boobs), pg99 the lingerie above her right(left side of image) leg, etc. Tho still left pg176 (her hair+fingers, bottom right panel), but I'll try and fix that next upload.

Update3(13.10): And so, it is done. After a long time, it is finally over. Hope you enjoy it and maybe even use it for a proper translation! One last thing, while I've tried to remove and fix as much as possible, sadly on page 184 I just lack the necessary skill to fill that gap properly...
